what_it_is: Self-expanding intracranial stent (vascular reconstruction device) for coil-assisted embolization of wide-neck aneurysms. Closed-cell design providing stability, conformability, and ease of use. Can be recaptured and redeployed after partial deployment. Radiopaque markers for visibility during and after deployment.
sizing_specs:
Stent Diameters (mm): 5 (for vessels 2.5–4)
Stent Lengths (mm): 16, 23, 30, 39
Materials: Nitinol, laser-cut, closed-cell design with platinum markers
indications: Authorized for use with embolic coils for treatment of wide-neck intracranial saccular or fusiform aneurysms arising from parent vessel diameter 2.5-4.0 mm. Wide-neck defined as neck width >= 4 mm or dome-to-neck ratio < 2. HUMANITARIAN DEVICE (USA ONLY).
compatible_with: Prowler EX Microcatheter, Prowler Select Plus (0.021 inch ID), TRUFILL n-BCA Liquid Embolic System, embolic coils
use_notes: Higher radial resistive force than Neuroform, LVIS Jr, and Solitaire 2/FR stents. Higher chronic outward force than LVIS Jr and Solitaire 2/FR. Higher point load force than Neuroform, LVIS Jr, and Solitaire. Better wall apposition in curved vessels and excellent kink resistance vs ENTERPRISE 1. Less foreshortening than LVIS Jr and Solitaire 2/FR.
